title: T2.1: app.rs — Type and Epic command handlers, type validation, --type filter, epic create

text:
Requirements: R17, R18, R19, R30. Files: src/app.rs.
AC: Type List/Add/Remove handlers; Epic Create with two-event pattern in single lock; Epic Add delegates to Relate parent-of; Epic List filters to epic type; Epic Show delegates; New handler validates type and writes StoryTypeSet; SetFields validates and emits StoryTypeSet; List handler --type filter including --type none; unknown type returns AppError::Validation.
